ICC World Test Championship Standings Update: New Zealand Claims Top Spot as South Africa Jumps to Second

01 Nov 2026, 05:33 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.icc-cricket.com

The ICC World Test Championship (WTC) 2025–27 cycle has reached a pivotal juncture following a flurry of international red-ball fixtures. The latest standings update highlights significant movement at the top of the table, with New Zealand claiming the number one ranking and defending champions South Africa climbing into second place following a hard-fought series victory against Australia.

Current Standings Overview

The latest points percentages and positions reflect a competitive cycle across continents:

  • New Zealand: 1st place (72.22%)
  • South Africa: 2nd place (71.43%)
  • Australia: 3rd place (69.23%)
  • India: 4th place (51.52%)
  • Bangladesh: 5th place (47.62%)
  • England: 6th place (38.54%)
  • Sri Lanka: 7th place (33.33%)
  • West Indies: 8th place (26.92%)
  • Pakistan: 9th place (4.63%)

Key Series Results and Team Form

New Zealand and South Africa Ascend

New Zealand ascended to the summit of the standings after South Africa defeated Australia. The Black Caps hold a 72.22 points percentage, bolstered by series victories including a 2-1 away triumph over England. Devon Conway leads their batting with 676 runs, while Jacob Duffy tops their bowling charts with 27 wickets in the cycle.

South Africa reclaimed the second spot after bouncing back from an opening defeat to secure a 2-1 home series win against Australia. Trailing 1-0 after a loss in Durban, the Proteas responded with victories in Gqeberha and Cape Town. Ryan Rickelton has scored 435 runs for the defending champions, while Simon Harmer leads their bowling with 42 wickets.

Australia Slip to Third

Australia dropped out of the top two following their series defeat in South Africa, bringing their points percentage to 69.23%. Travis Head (1124 runs) and Mitchell Starc (73 wickets) remain their leading contributors in the ongoing cycle as the 2023 champions prepare for upcoming series against New Zealand and India.

Chasing Pack and Lower Ranks

India sits fourth with a 51.52% points percentage following a 1-0 away series win in Sri Lanka and a home series loss to South Africa. Bangladesh occupies fifth place (47.62%), while England sits sixth (38.54%) after victories against Pakistan, though impacted by over-rate penalties. Sri Lanka, West Indies, and Pakistan round out the lower half of the table, with Pakistan facing a tough campaign affected by both losses and point deductions for slow over-rates.

Practical Implications and Verification

Teams are actively competing to secure a finish in the top two positions to qualify for the WTC Final. Fans and analysts looking to verify live standings, detailed scorecards, and official updates can consult the official International Cricket Council (ICC) World Test Championship portal online.
